# SPD-099 — Refuse a brief that is the single character '-' in ticket new and member new

## Brief
SPD-097's ticket row and SPUD-097/Vitelotte's member row both hold the brief '-': a '--brief -' typed for '--brief @-' passes the non-empty check and loses the whole brief, so the member worked from its spawn prompt alone.

Evidence: spud ticket show SPD-097 and spud member show SPUD-097/Vitelotte --json print brief '-'; ops.plan_member checks only that the brief is non-blank; cliparser.text_arg reads stdin for '@-' and returns '-' unchanged.
